recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for this issue unless a future work group decision wants to rename the current resultForCreate/resultForDelete elements or alter their semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-28489 requested clarification of SubscriptionTopic queryCriteria relationships between previous/current criteria, requireBoth, and nullness when previous state is absent on create or current state is absent on delete, proposing an explicit previousNotFoundPasses-style behavior flag or code list.
initial_application: The change appears to have been pre-applied by commit 4f3fcec0394f15c2c0a93f377b15fd0b866b3c9f ('First pass of FHIR#28489'), which added previous/current not-exists behavior fields and a CriteriaNotExistsBehavior code list to the historical SubscriptionTopic spreadsheet. Later source refactoring moved this into the current XML StructureDefinition and trigger naming.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes recorded the issue as Persuasive 15-0-0 and noted it was duplicated or pre-applied. The current build has SubscriptionTopic active in source/fhir.ini and maps the older resourceTrigger queryCriteria paths to current trigger queryCriteria paths. FHIR-39025 later clarified the same flags and is already audited on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current structuredefinition-SubscriptionTopic.xml contains resultForCreate and resultForDelete bound to CriteriaNotExistsBehavior, the code system defines test-passes/test-fails, requireBoth explains interaction with those flags, and subscriptiontopic-notes.xml provides create/delete/update narrative and a behavior table.
